subject: C39
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:150-153,238-240 and features/administration/runtime-changes.tsx:209-229: the new Close review control unmounts the editor without flushing its pending Gateway draft. Its passive cleanup reads editor.current after React has detached the textarea. An independent production-component probe edited a new route and immediately clicked Close review: no saveGatewayDraft was dispatched, even after 900 ms; waiting before closing dispatched the exact text as a positive control. This silently loses recent work despite the draft-preservation promise. Flush fresh editor input before removal on X, Escape and scrim exits, while retaining context checks and never applying anything. Acceptance: tests through the actual v2 sheet preserve an edit closed before the 800 ms delay and verify the exact saved text.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/gateway-tabs.tsx:233-252 and administration.tsx:251,338-339: draftNote is a React element captured into sheet state when the review opens. Later gateway.local.problem/unsaved changes cannot update that element, and saveGatewayDraft outcomes are ignored. Independently pushing problem='incomplete' and unsaved=true left the open sheet saying 'Your edits are kept on this Mac'. Operators cannot tell that their draft was rejected or not persisted. Derive the open sheet's save status from current observed state and distinguish pending, rejected and failed saves. Acceptance: an already-open Gateway editor updates after incomplete/credential/oversize rejection and storage failure, then clears the warning only when the current save is established.

R3 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/observation-tabs.tsx:276-313,497-580: Red Team source coverage is rendered only on Overview. Scans, Targets, Attack results and Reports omit the scan source's completeness, reported total and failure reason; the empty-filter copy even points to nonexistent 'coverage above'. An independent probe with one scan of 250 and complete=false showed no partial marker or total on Scans, Targets or Reports, while Overview showed both. Expose the relevant source coverage on every dependent tab, including empty and denied reads. Acceptance: production v2 tests distinguish complete, partial/capped, unknown-total and failed scan sources on these tabs without treating a sample as complete.

R4 [P2] apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css:205-206 and tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c39.py:149-162: the narrow-table fix removes every header row with display:none without adding cell labels. Both retained 900x600/200% AX trees omit Name, ID and Used by from the Custom topics table, leaving unlabeled stacked values. The native helper claims to check headers but only checks container containment, so N04 passes this regression. Preserve accessible column relationships and readable field labels during reflow. Acceptance: both themes at 200% retain identifiable fields in captures and AX output, and native assertions fail when those labels disappear.
